name: com.kentapplied/data
title: Kent Applied healthcare data
description: Sourced US healthcare facts, chart data and research from kentapplied.com. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Searches the sourced healthcare facts published at kentapplied.com/facts by keyword or topic. Returns up to 10 facts. Each has its number, a one-sentence statement, the original source with where in it the figure appears, the date Kent Applied checked it against that source, a link to the fact's page and the credit line for reuse (CC BY 4.0).

query.description: A few keywords, such as 'claim denials' or 'rural hospitals'.
query.title: Query

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 10.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_chart_data
tools.description: Returns the data behind one chart in the library at kentapplied.com/charts, by its slug. Includes the title, subtitle, data rows, units, how Kent Applied made the chart, the source line and original sources, the date checked, links to the chart page and its CSV download, and the credit line for reuse (CC BY 4.0). Lists longer than 500 items are cut, and the CSV has them all.

slug.description: The chart's slug, the last part of its address: kentapplied.com/charts/<slug>/.
slug.title: Slug

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Searches the research, data stories and blog posts published at kentapplied.com/insights by keyword or topic. Returns up to 10 pages. Each has its title, kind, summary, publish date, the sources it names, the date its figures were checked, a link and the credit line (CC BY 4.0).

query.description: A few keywords, such as 'claim denials' or 'rural hospitals'.
query.title: Query

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 10.
limit.title: Limit
